description: Document Upload and Translation - Allow users to upload PDF, DOCX, or TXT files, parse the content, translate it using their chosen provider, and return the translated document. Includes file upload endpoint, document parsing service, async job processing via Redis queue, and job status tracking.
steps: Add python-docx, PyPDF2 (or pypdf), and python-multipart to pyproject.toml dependencies.

Create src/api/models/document_job.py - SQLAlchemy model for document translation jobs (id, user_id, original_filename, file_size_bytes, source_lang, target_lang, provider, status [pending, processing, completed, failed], error_message, created_at, completed_at).

Create src/api/services/document_parser.py - DocumentParser class with methods: parse_pdf(file_bytes) -> str, parse_docx(file_bytes) -> str, parse_txt(file_bytes) -> str. Extracts text content from uploaded files. Include content chunking logic for large documents (split into chunks under 5000 chars for translation).

Create src/api/services/document_translator.py - DocumentTranslator class that: (a) takes parsed text chunks, (b) translates each chunk using the selected provider via ProviderManager, (c) reassembles the translated text, (d) updates job status in DB. Handles errors gracefully per-chunk.

Create src/api/routers/documents.py - endpoints: POST /api/v1/documents/translate (multipart upload with source_lang, target_lang, provider params - creates job, starts background translation), GET /api/v1/documents/jobs (list user's jobs), GET /api/v1/documents/jobs/{job_id} (job status + result), GET /api/v1/documents/jobs/{job_id}/download (download translated text as file).
Create src/api/models/document_result.py - model to store translated document content (job_id, translated_content, chunk_count, total_characters).
Register the documents router in src/api/main.py.
Add file size limits (10MB max) and supported format validation in the upload endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/documents/translate accepts multipart file upload (PDF, DOCX, TXT)
Document parsing correctly extracts text from all three formats
Large documents are chunked and translated piece by piece
Users can check job status and retrieve results via GET endpoints
Job status transitions: pending -> processing -> completed/failed
File size limited to 10MB with clear error messages
Provider selection works same as text translate (marianmt default, BYOK, admin credits)
verification: Run pytest tests/ -v to confirm existing tests still pass
Run python -c 'from src.api.services.document_parser import DocumentParser; print("OK")' to verify parser imports
Run python -c 'from src.api.routers.documents import router; print(router.routes)' to verify router loads
